blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Bacolod City has recorded its sixth dengue death of the year on Tuesday after an 8-year-old girl from Barangay Handumanan succumbed to severe complications from the mosquito-borne virus. The City Health Office said that the child passed away at a Bacolod hospital due to multiple organ dysfunction syndrome secondary to severe dengue,
